description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Join an early-stage AI-enabled appraisal technology company as a founding full-stack engineer. You will build the core product and operational systems used by appraisers, operations teams, and enterprise lenders, with end-to-end ownership of features.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Build and ship full-stack product features for appraisers, operations teams, and enterprise lenders.

 - Use AI-assisted development tools to move quickly while maintaining software quality.

 - Turn appraisal, compliance, and lender workflows into clear, maintainable software.

 - Help shape engineering culture and processes as the team grows.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - Zero to three years of experience, including early-stage engineering work or shipped projects, internships, or hackathon projects.

 - Strong full-stack fundamentals and experience building frontend and backend components.

 - Daily fluency with AI-assisted development tools such as Cursor, Claude Code, Copilot, or similar.

 - Ability to translate real-world workflows into software, with experience building tools or internal systems for operational teams.

 - Comfort with ambiguity and a strong sense of ownership in an early-stage environment.

 - Experience with regulated industries or compliance-heavy requirements is useful.

 - Must be authorized to work in the United States without H-1B sponsorship.


COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

Base salary is $120,000 to $150,000 annually, depending on experience, plus equity. Candidates on OPT are welcome. O-1 sponsorship may be considered for exceptional candidates.


LOCATION

On-site in New York, NY. Remote work may be possible for exceptional candidates.
